dataset_name: Indonesia packaged food labels and nutrition snapshot
scope: Products returned by the Open Food Facts API with countries_tags_en=indonesia, first 20 pages at page_size=100, sorted by unique_scans_n.
license: Open Database License (ODbL); individual contents under Database Contents License (DbCL); read the source terms before redistribution.
limitations: This is not a complete census of Indonesian food products.
Open Food Facts is community-contributed; records are not independently verified by this package.
A missing value is preserved as empty and flagged; no values were invented or imputed.
The API result is a snapshot and may change; raw API responses are included for auditability.
Organic, halal, additive, and nutrition labels are recorded only when present in the source record.

collections.name: panganku_ifct_foods
collections.scope: Official searchable table index from Indonesian Food Composition Table (IFCT).

collections.name: indonesia_packaged_foods
collections.scope: First successful pages of products returned with countries_tags_en=indonesia, sorted by unique_scans_n.

package_notes: Combined snapshot contains 1,646 records from two sources. Raw files and parsers are included for auditability and reruns.
